question: Tell me about B.Sc. Data Science at DSU, including duration, eligibility, annual fee and career opportunities.
response_text:
**Answer:**

Eligibility requires a 10+2 (PUC) pass with Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Technology or Informatics Practices as a compulsory subject and a minimum of 45 % aggregate (40 % for SC/ST). The annual tuition fee is ₹1,62,000 (₹87,000 for Term 1 and ₹75,000 for Term 2). For detailed information on career opportunities, placement records and specific recruiter details, please contact the DSU Placement/Admissions Cell.

**Key details:**
- **Duration:** 3 years (full‑time) 【Recent conversation context】  
- **Eligibility:** 10+2/PUC with Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, IT or Informatics Practices; minimum 45 % marks (40 % for SC/ST) 【Source 3】  
- **Annual fee:** ₹1,62,000 per year (Term 1 ₹87,000 + Term 2 ₹75,000) 【Recent conversation context】  
- **Career opportunities:** Specific placement statistics, average/highest packages and recruiter list are not detailed in the publicly available sources; please obtain official confirmation.  

**Official sources:**  
- [Eligibility Criteria – B.Sc. Data Science](https://www.dsu.edu.in/computer-applications/bsc-data-science/eligibility-bsc-ds) (Source 3)  
- General programme information can be accessed via the DSU Admissions portal: https://www.dsu.edu.in/eligibility

question: I want to know the hostel fee, mess charges and transport fee, but I have not decided which course to join. Can you help me identify the details that need confirmation?
response_text:
**Answer:**  
Dayananda Sagar University provides on‑campus hostel accommodation only at the Main Campus (Harohalli). The hostel fee payable each academic year includes accommodation, mess (food) and laundry services, but the exact monetary amount for the hostel fee, the separate mess charge, and the annual transport fee are not specified in the publicly available fee schedules. These amounts must be confirmed directly with the university.

**Key details:**
- **Hostel accommodation** – Available at the Main Campus (Harohalli) and includes rooms, 24/7 security, Wi‑Fi, gym, healthcare, laundry and a multi‑cuisine mess. The total fee covers accommodation **plus** mess and laundry for the academic year. No specific fee amount is listed on the official page. 【[Hostel Fees & Facilities](https://www.dsu.edu.in/9-explore/1575-hostel-fee)】
- **Mess charges** – Mess services are part of the overall hostel fee; a separate mess‑only charge is not published separately. The exact mess component amount requires official confirmation. 【[Hostel Fees & Facilities](https://www.dsu.edu.in/9-explore/1575-hostel-fee)】
- **Transport fee** – DSU operates a fleet of buses linking the Main Campus with major Bengaluru hubs. Transport fees are billed annually and vary according to the designated pickup zone, but the precise fee structure is not disclosed on the website. 【[Campus Transportation](https://www.dsu.edu.in/campus-life)】
- **Campus limitation** – Hostel facilities are confirmed only for the Main Campus. Students attending the City Innovation Campus (Kudlu Gate) should contact the hostel administration desk for any local lodging options. 【[Hostel Fees & Facilities](https://www.dsu.edu.in/9-explore/1575-hostel-fee)】

**Next step:**  
For the confirmed hostel fee (including mess) and the exact transport fee applicable to your situation, please contact the DSU Admissions Cell or submit an enquiry using the form below. This will allow the university to provide the precise amounts based on the programme and zone you eventually choose.  

You can submit your enquiry here: **[DSU Admissions Enquiry Form](https://www.dsu.edu.in/admissions/enquiry)**.
